name: Gemini
description: Google's multimodal AI assistant powered by the Gemini model family, deeply integrated with Google Workspace and offering long-context understanding, image generation via Imagen 3, and Google Search grounding.

writing-chat.summary: Gemini provides conversational AI with multimodal inputs, supporting text generation with Google Search grounding, adjustable response styles, and seamless integration with Gmail and Google Docs for drafting assistance.

subFeatures.name: Multimodal Chat
subFeatures.description: Converse with text, images, audio, and video inputs in a single conversation, leveraging Gemini's natively multimodal architecture

subFeatures.name: Google Search Grounding
subFeatures.description: Responses can be grounded in real-time Google Search results, with inline citations and a 'double-check' feature to verify claims

subFeatures.name: Gmail Draft Assistance
subFeatures.description: Draft, reply to, and refine emails directly within Gmail using Gemini's writing capabilities

subFeatures.name: Response Modification
subFeatures.description: Modify response length, tone (professional, casual, etc.), and simplicity level after generation

limitations: Free tier uses Gemini Flash model with lower quality than Advanced tier's Gemini Pro/Ultra
Long conversations can lose coherence in earlier context
Google Search grounding not always activated automatically
Cannot customize system-level instructions in the consumer interface

pricingTiers.details: Gemini Flash model, basic chat with Google Search grounding
Gemini 2.5 Pro, 1M token context, Google One AI Premium with 2TB storage
Gemini for Workspace, enterprise-grade data protection
Advanced security, compliance, admin controls, full Workspace AI integration

versionHistory.changes: Thinking model with 1M token context and multimodal reasoning
Fast multimodal model with tool use and agentic capabilities
1M token context window, improved multimodal understanding
First Ultra-tier model powering Gemini Advanced

research.summary: Gemini offers strong research capabilities through real-time Google Search integration, Deep Research for autonomous multi-step investigation, and the companion NotebookLM product for document-based research.

subFeatures.name: Google Search Integration
subFeatures.description: Real-time web search powered by Google's search engine, providing grounded responses with inline source citations

subFeatures.name: Deep Research
subFeatures.description: Autonomous multi-step research agent that creates a research plan, browses dozens of websites, and produces a comprehensive report with citations

subFeatures.name: Double-Check Response
subFeatures.description: Verify factual claims in Gemini's response against Google Search results, with green/orange highlighting showing supported vs. unsupported claims

subFeatures.name: NotebookLM Integration
subFeatures.description: Companion product for uploading documents and generating insights, summaries, and audio overviews from source material

limitations: Deep Research limited to Advanced tier subscribers
Google Search grounding can introduce search result biases
Double-check feature is surface-level verification, not deep fact-checking
NotebookLM is a separate product, not integrated into Gemini chat

pricingTiers.details: Google Search grounding, Double-Check
Deep Research agent, priority search integration
Full research capabilities with data governance

versionHistory.changes: Multi-step autonomous research agent with report generation
Fact verification against Google Search results
Real-time Google Search integration in responses

file-analysis.summary: Gemini excels at multimodal file analysis with native support for documents, images, video, and audio, featuring the largest context window of any major AI model at 1M tokens for processing long files.

subFeatures.name: Document Analysis
subFeatures.description: Upload and analyze PDFs, Google Docs, text files, and spreadsheets with the full context window for long document comprehension

subFeatures.name: Image Understanding
subFeatures.description: Analyze photos, diagrams, charts, screenshots, and handwritten content using Gemini's native vision capabilities

subFeatures.name: Video Understanding
subFeatures.description: Upload and analyze video files, including YouTube URLs, with ability to answer questions about specific frames, scenes, and audio content

subFeatures.name: Audio Analysis
subFeatures.description: Process and transcribe audio files, answer questions about spoken content, and analyze music or sound recordings

subFeatures.name: Google Drive Integration
subFeatures.description: Access and analyze files directly from Google Drive without manual upload

limitations: Video analysis limited to shorter clips on free tier
1M token context only available on Advanced tier with Gemini 2.5 Pro
Cannot process password-protected or DRM files
Audio analysis quality depends on recording clarity
No code execution environment for data processing (unlike ChatGPT's ADA)

pricingTiers.details: Image and basic document analysis with Flash model
Video, audio, long document analysis with 1M token context
Full multimodal analysis with Drive integration and data governance

versionHistory.changes: Enhanced multimodal reasoning across all file types
Native video and audio analysis with Gemini 1.5 Pro
Million-token context window for long document processing

document-creation.summary: Gemini creates documents primarily through Google Workspace integration, generating content directly in Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides, with the ability to draft, format, and refine documents within the Google ecosystem.

subFeatures.name: Google Docs Generation
subFeatures.description: Generate and export responses as Google Docs, or use 'Help me write' sidebar in Google Docs for in-document AI assistance

subFeatures.name: Google Slides Creation
subFeatures.description: Generate presentation slides with content and formatting suggestions using Gemini in Google Slides

subFeatures.name: Google Sheets Assistance
subFeatures.description: Generate formulas, create tables, and organize data in Google Sheets with AI assistance

subFeatures.name: Formatted Chat Output
subFeatures.description: Generate structured responses with markdown formatting, tables, and code blocks directly in the Gemini chat interface

limitations: Document creation tightly coupled to Google Workspace — limited outside Google ecosystem
No standalone document editor like ChatGPT Canvas or Claude Artifacts
Slides generation produces basic layouts, not designer-quality presentations
No native SVG, diagram, or visualization creation in chat
Workspace AI features require separate Business/Enterprise subscription

pricingTiers.details: Formatted text output in chat only
Export to Google Docs, basic Workspace integration
Full Workspace AI: Docs, Sheets, Slides, Meet
All document creation with admin controls and compliance

versionHistory.changes: Gemini integrated into Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Meet
Export Gemini responses directly as Google Docs

image-generation.summary: Gemini generates images using Google's Imagen 3 model, offering high-quality photorealistic and artistic image generation directly within the chat interface with strong text rendering in images.

subFeatures.name: Imagen 3 Generation
subFeatures.description: Create high-quality images from text prompts using Google DeepMind's Imagen 3 model, with strong photorealism and text-in-image capabilities

subFeatures.name: Image Editing
subFeatures.description: Edit generated or uploaded images through conversational instructions to modify specific elements

subFeatures.name: Style Versatility
subFeatures.description: Generate images across multiple styles including photorealistic, illustration, artistic, and abstract

subFeatures.name: SynthID Watermarking
subFeatures.description: All generated images include invisible SynthID digital watermarks for AI content identification

limitations: Cannot generate images of identifiable real people
Image generation may be slower than competitors
Limited image editing compared to DALL-E 3 inpainting
Generated images have resolution limits
Content policy restrictions on certain categories are stricter than some competitors

pricingTiers.details: Imagen 3 image generation with daily limits
Higher generation limits and priority access
Image generation with enterprise content policies

versionHistory.changes: Major quality upgrade with better text rendering and photorealism
Initial image generation in Gemini via Imagen 2

prototyping.summary: Gemini offers limited prototyping through code generation in chat and integration with Google AI Studio for testing prompts and API calls, but lacks a live code preview environment like Claude Artifacts.

subFeatures.name: Code Generation
subFeatures.description: Generate code in major programming languages with syntax highlighting and explanations in the chat interface

subFeatures.name: Google AI Studio
subFeatures.description: Prompt engineering and prototyping environment for testing Gemini API calls, with structured output and function calling configuration

subFeatures.name: Google Colab Integration
subFeatures.description: Gemini can generate Python code exportable to Google Colab notebooks for execution and iteration

limitations: No in-browser code execution or live preview in Gemini chat
No equivalent to Claude Artifacts React rendering or ChatGPT Code Interpreter
Google AI Studio is a separate developer tool, not integrated into consumer Gemini
Cannot run or test code directly within the conversation
Prototyping workflow requires switching between Gemini and external tools

pricingTiers.details: Code generation in chat, Google AI Studio access
Higher quality code generation with Gemini 2.5 Pro
Code generation with enterprise security policies

versionHistory.changes: Developer-focused prompt prototyping environment
Code generation capabilities in Gemini chat at launch

personalization.summary: Gemini offers personalization through Gems — custom AI experts that users can create with specific instructions, personality, and expertise for recurring use cases.

subFeatures.name: Gems
subFeatures.description: Custom AI personas with specific instructions, tone, and expertise that persist as reusable chatbot configurations for tasks like coding coach, writing editor, or learning tutor

subFeatures.name: Saved Information
subFeatures.description: Gemini can remember user preferences and facts shared in conversations to personalize future responses

subFeatures.name: Response Style Preferences
subFeatures.description: Adjust default response length, formality, and detail level through settings

limitations: Gems require Advanced subscription
No equivalent to ChatGPT's Custom Instructions for free tier users
Saved information is limited and cannot be bulk-managed
Gems are personal — cannot share with team members
Fewer customization options compared to ChatGPT Custom GPTs

pricingTiers.details: Basic response style preferences only
Gems custom AI experts, saved information
Admin-managed Gems for team use cases

versionHistory.changes: Custom AI expert personas for recurring tasks
Cross-conversation preference and fact memory

persistent-context.summary: Gemini provides persistent context through conversation history, Gems with embedded instructions, and its industry-leading 1M token context window that enables processing entire codebases or book-length documents in a single session.

subFeatures.name: 1M Token Context Window
subFeatures.description: Process up to 1 million tokens in a single conversation, enabling analysis of entire books, codebases, or large document collections

subFeatures.name: Conversation History
subFeatures.description: All conversations saved with search functionality for resuming previous threads

subFeatures.name: Gem Persistence
subFeatures.description: Custom Gems maintain their instructions and context configuration across all sessions

limitations: 1M context only available with Gemini 2.5 Pro on Advanced tier
No project-based organization for grouping related conversations
No persistent knowledge base that carries across conversations
Conversation context resets with each new thread
Free tier limited to shorter context windows

pricingTiers.details: Conversation history with standard context window
1M token context, Gem persistence, full history
Full context capabilities with data retention controls

versionHistory.changes: Million-token context window with Gemini 1.5 Pro
Persistent custom AI configurations across sessions

agents.summary: Gemini is developing agentic capabilities with Project Mariner for browser-based tasks, Deep Research for autonomous investigation, and the Gemini API's tool use framework for building custom agents.

subFeatures.name: Deep Research Agent
subFeatures.description: Autonomous research agent that plans a multi-step investigation, browses the web, and produces comprehensive reports with citations

subFeatures.name: Gemini API Tool Use
subFeatures.description: Function calling and tool integration through the Gemini API for building custom agentic workflows with structured outputs

subFeatures.name: Project Mariner (Experimental)
subFeatures.description: Experimental browser agent that can navigate websites and complete multi-step tasks like filling forms and making purchases

subFeatures.name: Google Workspace Actions
subFeatures.description: Take actions within Google Workspace apps like scheduling meetings, sending emails, and creating documents

limitations: Project Mariner still experimental and not generally available
Workspace Actions limited to Google ecosystem
No general-purpose computer use or desktop automation
Agent capabilities fragmented across experimental features
Deep Research limited to information gathering, cannot take external actions

pricingTiers.details: No agent capabilities
Deep Research agent
Google Workspace Actions
Full agent suite with admin controls

versionHistory.changes: Experimental browser agent for web-based task automation
Autonomous multi-step research agent
Enhanced function calling and agentic tool integration

connectors.summary: Gemini has deep native integration with the Google ecosystem through Extensions, connecting to Google Search, Maps, Flights, Hotels, YouTube, and the full Google Workspace suite.

subFeatures.name: Google Workspace Extensions
subFeatures.description: Native integration with Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Calendar for reading and writing data across Workspace apps

subFeatures.name: Google Search Extension
subFeatures.description: Real-time Google Search grounding providing current information with source citations

subFeatures.name: Google Maps Extension
subFeatures.description: Location-aware queries, directions, and place information directly in Gemini conversations

subFeatures.name: YouTube Extension
subFeatures.description: Search and summarize YouTube videos, find relevant content, and get information from video descriptions

subFeatures.name: Google Flights and Hotels
subFeatures.description: Search flights and hotels with pricing, compare options, and get travel recommendations

limitations: Extensions limited to Google ecosystem — no native third-party integrations
No open connector protocol like Anthropic's MCP
Cannot connect to Slack, GitHub, Notion, or other non-Google tools natively
Workspace extensions require organizational admin approval for Business/Enterprise
Extension data access governed by Google's data processing terms

pricingTiers.details: Google Search, Maps, YouTube, Flights, Hotels extensions
All extensions plus Google Drive and Workspace integration
Full Workspace integration with admin-managed extensions

versionHistory.changes: Deep Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides integration
Google Search, Maps, YouTube, Flights, Hotels extensions at Gemini launch

dictation.summary: Gemini supports voice input on mobile and web with real-time speech-to-text, plus a conversational Gemini Live mode for natural spoken interaction on mobile devices.

subFeatures.name: Gemini Live
subFeatures.description: Real-time conversational voice mode on mobile devices with natural back-and-forth dialogue, ability to interrupt, and multiple voice options

subFeatures.name: Voice Input
subFeatures.description: Speech-to-text input for dictating prompts on mobile and web interfaces using Google's speech recognition

subFeatures.name: Voice Selection
subFeatures.description: Choose from multiple natural-sounding voices for Gemini Live responses

limitations: Gemini Live requires Advanced subscription
Gemini Live initially limited to Android, later expanded to iOS
Voice mode cannot access Extensions or tools during conversation
No voice mode on web interface — mobile only for Gemini Live
Standard voice input quality dependent on device microphone

pricingTiers.details: Basic voice input on mobile and web
Gemini Live with multiple voices and natural conversation

versionHistory.changes: Conversational voice mode with natural dialogue on mobile
Speech-to-text input at Gemini launch
